name: Nagi Eunoe
source:
A shrine maiden candidate serving the Holy Kingdom.

She has a glamorous, beautiful face and a free-spirited personality.
A futanari girl without testicles.
There is extra skin on her shaft; unless it is pulled back the tip stays hidden. She has never revealed this to anyone.
She has a strong interest in service to the gods and in the pleasures of the body; when she takes part in the rites, intense passion is visible in her.
She has built a calm relationship with Mirine, but because only one of them can be chosen as the official shrine maiden, she also harbors competitive feelings and complicated emotions.
Those feelings are not hostility or jealousy so much as something close to respect and yearning toward her.

The slightly teasing, loaded attitude she sometimes shows is also a mask to hide her true feelings.

[From the [url=https://www.ordin-soft.com/hutanari_miko.html]official website[/url]]
